question_text.zh: 一家公司需要训练一个机器学习模型来分类不同类型动物的图像。该公司拥有一个大型的标注图像数据集,并且不会标注更多数据。 公司应该使用哪种学习类型来训练模型?
question_text.en: A company needs to train an ML model to classify images of different types of animals. The company has a large dataset of labeled images and will not label more data. Which type of learning should the company use to train the model?

A.zh: 监督学习
A.en: Supervised learning

B.zh: 无监督学习
B.en: Unsupervised learning

C.zh: 强化学习
C.en: Reinforcement learning

D.zh: 主动学习
D.en: Active learning

A.zh: 正確。原因是，(监督学习 ): 正确。监督学习适用于有标签的数据集,模型通过学习输入数据与标签之间的关系来进行预测。题目明确提到有一个大规模的标注数据集,因此监督学习是最佳选择
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which type of learning should the company use to train the model?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，(无监督学习 ): 错误。无监督学习适用于没有标签的数据集,主要用于聚类或降维等任务。题目明确提到数据是有标签的,因此无监督学习不适用
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which type of learning should the company use to train the model? The source-supported choice is A. Supervised learning.

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，(强化学习 ): 错误。强化学习适用于通过试错方式与环境交互来学习策略的场景,通常用于游戏、机器人控制等任务。题目没有提到需要与环境交互,因此不适用
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which type of learning should the company use to train the model? The source-supported choice is A. Supervised learning.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，(主动学习 ): 错误。主动学习适用于需要动态标注数据的场景,而题目明确提到不会标注更多数据,因此主动学习不适用
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which type of learning should the company use to train the model? The source-supported choice is A. Supervised learning.

answer_text.zh: A. 监督学习
answer_text.en: A. Supervised learning
